project_type: Expo React Native mobile app (Expo SDK 50)
build_system: expo (no install possible - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network). Files can only be modified/created.
test_framework: No test framework configured in mobile app. Validation is visual/type-check only.
build_command: Cannot run build (no network for npm install). Validation via TypeScript type-checking in IDE only.
test_command: No test runner available. Validate by reading code for correctness.
verification_instructions: 1. Verify all existing business logic functions are preserved unchanged. 2. Verify imports resolve to existing modules. 3. Verify no new npm dependencies are introduced. 4. Verify TypeScript types are correct.
setup_instructions: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode prevents any setup.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot run expo start, cannot pull images. Only modify/create source files. No new dependencies allowed. Only React Native built-in Animated API available (no reanimated, no gesture-handler, no linear-gradient).
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing business logic, API integration, Redux state management, navigation, authentication, upload pipeline, and validation. Only improve UI/UX.
key_patterns: Screens export named components. StyleSheet.create for styles. lightColors/darkColors from theme/colors.ts. Feather and Ionicons from @expo/vector-icons. SafeAreaView wrapper. useAppSelector/useAppDispatch custom hooks.
directory_structure: mobile/src/screens/ - all screens grouped by feature. mobile/src/components/ - reusable components. mobile/src/services/ - API service layers. mobile/src/store/slices/ - Redux toolkit slices. mobile/src/theme/ - color definitions. mobile/src/utils/ - utility functions. mobile/src/navigation/ - React Navigation stacks and tabs.
